# Radicle seven-program replay pins: recorded from Radicle's own replay runs, not from the game.
# They are regression-only; no row here is evidence of game output.
# The format matches program_census.txt: `key value` lines, one group per
# program per game build. A group starts at a `program` line. Blank lines
# and `#` lines are ignored.
# A build with no rows is reported unpinned and does not fail. With rows,
# a snapshot, host-log or bgs-call mismatch fails the gate.
# game_build unknown
# program <basename, e.g. AtomicCommand.swf>
# build <file version, e.g. 1.11.240.0>
# snapshot <frame hash of the last replayed frame>
# hostlog <host-log hash of the replay>
# bgs_calls <bgs.* host calls during the replay>
